newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica North-West Co-op says maize tender passed.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica North-West Co-op says maize tender passed.

text.p: South Africa's North-West Co-operative Ltd said on Friday its tender for 34,650 tonnes of yellow maize had been passed.
"The tender was passed. We might put out a new tender at some future stage," a spokesman told Reuters.
The co-operative announced on Tuesday it would offer for export 34,650 tonnes of yellow maize grade YM1 with an option to deliver up to 20 percent of YM2 grade.
The maize was for delivery on September 15.
